plan.description: Freeze and hash the index test, reference, threshold rule and interval methods before labels.
Admit immutable subject identities, scores, reference labels, blinding and independent splits.
Refuse threshold tuning, verification and incorporation bias, leakage and degenerate denominators.
Compute Wilson proportions, exact-tie Mann-Whitney AUC and seeded bootstrap uncertainty.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate bounded claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
